test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the sentence that contains a spelling error.

options.text: The result will be declared tomorrow.
I shall always remain greatful to you.
His presence in the party was unexpected.

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"greatful"** is a misspelling. The correct word is "grateful," which means feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness; thankful. (आभारी) • **Example:** She was **grateful **for the help she received during her difficult times. • **"Grateful"** is the **correct spelling **and means feeling or showing thanks. (आभारी) • **Example:** I am** grateful **for your support and encouragement. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: The result will be declared tomorrow** (परिणाम कल घोषित किया जाएगा): This sentence is correct and does not contain any spelling errors. • **Example:** The result will be declared tomorrow at 10 AM. • **Option 3: His presence in the party was unexpected** (पार्टी में उनकी उपस्थिति अप्रत्याशित थी): This sentence is correct and does not contain any spelling errors. • **Example:** His presence in the party was unexpected but delightful. • **Option 4: I can’t believe you** (मुझे तुम पर विश्वास नहीं हो रहा): This sentence is correct and does not contain any spelling errors. • **Example:** I can't believe you actually did that. 21e:Tb76, The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
